items.title: For the Denver #Nuggets, losing Tim Hardaway Jr., Jonas Valanciunas, Bruce Brown, and even Jalen Pickett (who played almost as many minutes as Big Val) is pretty significant.
items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
For the Denver #Nuggets, losing Tim Hardaway Jr., Jonas Valanciunas, Bruce Brown, and even Jalen Pickett (who played almost as many minutes as Big Val) is pretty significant.

They lost ~30% of 2026's minutes, 3s, boards & steals, 27% of points, and 22% of assists & blocks.

items.title: Regardless of whether the #Nuggets bring Bruce Brown back or not, I find their decision to so quickly give his number away to a newly acquired player a bit strange and irksome.
items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
Regardless of whether the #Nuggets bring Bruce Brown back or not, I find their decision to so quickly give his number away to a newly acquired player a bit strange and irksome.

Even if BB's on his way out, no need for any salt in the wounds of such a beloved player.
